zodiacStory.aries: The golden-horned ram comes from the myth of the golden fleece; the constellation of Aries once marked the spring equinox.
zodiacStory.taurus: The white bull is Zeus in disguise in the myth of Europa; the constellation of Taurus holds Aldebaran and the Pleiades.
zodiacStory.gemini: The twins are Castor and Pollux, inseparable brothers of Greek myth; the constellation bears the name of both stars.
zodiacStory.cancer: The crab comes from Karkinos, sent by Hera against Heracles; the constellation of Cancer holds the Beehive cluster.
zodiacStory.leo: The lion is the one of Nemea, defeated by Heracles; the constellation of Leo holds Regulus, the lion's heart.
zodiacStory.virgo: The maiden is Astraea, the goddess of justice who left the Earth; the constellation of Virgo holds the star Spica, the ear of wheat.
zodiacStory.libra: The scales are the instrument Astraea uses to weigh destinies; it is the only zodiac sign shown as an object.
zodiacStory.scorpio: The scorpion wounded Orion in the myth; the constellation of Scorpio holds Antares, the red heart.
zodiacStory.sagittarius: The centaur archer aims his arrow at the heart of the Scorpion; the constellation holds the centre of the Milky Way.
zodiacStory.capricorn: The goat-fish is Amalthea, who nursed Zeus; the constellation lies toward the centre of the galaxy.
zodiacStory.aquarius: The water bearer is Ganymede, cupbearer of the gods; Aquarius lies in the sky's water constellation region.
zodiacStory.pisces: The two fish are Aphrodite and Eros, who transformed to escape Typhon; the constellation is tied to the vernal point.
chineseStory.rato: In the legend the Rat crossed the river on the Ox's back and leapt ahead at the finish. That is why it opens the cycle.
chineseStory.boi: The Ox carried the Rat across the river with patience; its quiet strength stands for work and trust.
chineseStory.tigre: The Tiger is king of the mountains and arrived third, a symbol of courage before the unknown.
chineseStory.coelho: The Rabbit leapt from stone to stone and took fourth place, a symbol of grace and prudence.
chineseStory.dragao: The Dragon stopped to bring rain to the villages and arrived after the Rabbit, showing that power can serve the good.
chineseStory.serpente: The Snake coiled around the Dragon's leg and came sixth, a symbol of wisdom and strategy.
chineseStory.cavalo: The Horse is the seventh animal, a free spirit that crosses the plains in motion.
chineseStory.cabra: The Goat arrived eighth, sharing the path with the Monkey, in a gesture of kindness and cooperation.
chineseStory.macaco: The Monkey is ninth, a clever bridge-builder, a symbol of intelligence and wit.
chineseStory.galo: The Rooster is tenth, the bird that announces dawn with punctuality and discipline.
chineseStory.cao: The Dog is eleventh, the faithful guardian who protects the home and those we love.
chineseStory.porco: The Pig closed the cycle in twelfth place, a symbol of generosity and abundance.

services.s1Detail.what: A mathematical photograph of the sky at the exact moment of birth. Astrologers call this the "radix", the zero point from which the whole life is read.
services.s1Detail.input:
Date of birth (day, month, year)
Exact time of birth (minutes matter)
City/place of birth (to compute geographic coordinates and the time zone)
services.s1Detail.tech:
Positions of the planets (Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto) in degrees, minutes and seconds within the 12 signs, using ephemerides (astronomical tables of planetary positions).
Astrological houses, the division of the sky into 12 sectors (Ascendant, Midheaven, etc.), computed with mathematical systems such as Placidus, Koch or Whole Sign. The Ascendant is the sign rising on the eastern horizon at the moment of birth.
Aspects, the angles between planets (conjunction 0°, sextile 60°, square 90°, trine 120°, opposition 180°). Each angle carries an interpretation of harmony or tension.
services.s1Detail.result:
Talent profile (well-aspected planets and strong houses)
Challenges (tense aspects, retrograde planets)
The "path", with the reading of the life theme, vocation and behaviour patterns
services.s2Detail.what: A symbolic system that reduces names and dates to numbers from 1 to 9 (plus the master numbers 11, 22, 33) and interprets those archetypes.
services.s2Detail.input:
Full name (as registered)
Date of birth
services.s2Detail.tech:
Life Path Number: add day + month + year of birth and reduce to a single digit. E.g.: 20/09/1986 → 2+0+0+9+1+9+8+6 = 35 → 3+5 = 8. It is the "core theme" of the life.
Expression Number: converts each letter of the name into a number (A=1, B=2... I=9, J=1...) using the Pythagorean Table and adds them all up. Reveals talents and how the person expresses themselves.
Personality Number: computed only with the consonants. How others see you.
Soul/Inner Drive Number: only with the vowels. Deep desires.
Personal years: 9-year cycles that indicate the most favourable periods for each type of action (starting, harvesting, resting).
services.s2Detail.result:
The life purpose (Life Path)
The cycles and the years of greatest potential
Numerical compatibility with other people
services.s3Detail.what: A personality model with 9 types (the "enneagram" = nine-pointed figure). Unlike the natal chart and numerology, it is not computed from data, but identified through behaviour patterns, motivations and fears.
services.s3Detail.input:
Self-perception questionnaire (or interview)
History of recurring patterns (relationships, work, reactions to conflict)
services.s3Detail.tech:
The 9 types (1 Reformer, 2 Helper, 3 Achiever, 4 Individualist, 5 Investigator, 6 Loyalist, 7 Enthusiast, 8 Challenger, 9 Peacemaker)
Centres of intelligence: Instinctive (types 8, 9, 1), Emotional (2, 3, 4), Mental (5, 6, 7)
Wings: the neighbouring type that influences behaviour
Levels of health: from healthy to neurotic
Instinctual subtypes: self-preservation, social, sexual
services.s3Detail.result:
Identification of the dominant type
The patterns that repeat throughout the story (why the person always acts the same way in conflict)
The path of growth (the "arrow" toward the healthy type)
services.s4Detail.what: The overlay of two natal charts (or two numbers) to measure the harmony between two people.
services.s4Detail.input: Natal chart (or date/name) of each person
services.s4Detail.tech:
Synastry: comparison of one person's planets with the other's. E.g.: A's Sun in conjunction with B's Moon = strong emotional attraction; A's Venus square B's Mars = passionate tension.
Composite chart: a "relationship chart" created by the midpoint between the two sets of planets. Shows how the couple works as a unit.
Overlay houses: where one person's planets fall into the other's houses (e.g.: A's Sun in B's 7th house = partner A "activates" B's partnership area).
services.s4Detail.result:
Reading of love, friendship and work partnerships
Strengths of the union and friction areas
A practical recommendation on how to balance the dynamic
services.s5Detail.what: The most "human" and immediate service. It is not a report, but an interactive consultation for specific questions.
services.s5Detail.input:
The client's urgent question or decision
Optionally, the natal chart or numerology as a reading base
services.s5Detail.tech:
Combined reading: crosses the three tools (astrology + numerology + enneagram) to answer the specific question
Current transits: where the planets are now relative to the natal chart (e.g.: Jupiter transiting the 10th house = career expansion moment)
Practical guidance: not just prediction, but actionable advice
services.s5Detail.result:
Direct answer to the question
Astrological/numerological context of that moment
A suggested action plan
